question: What division of eightfold groups is sought to be fully known?
premises: A division is the object of inquiry
The division consists of eightfold groups
Complete knowledge of it is desired without limit
inference: The speaker seeks to know fully the division of the eightfold groups in its endless extent.
uncertainties: anantathā may qualify the manner of knowing or the extent of the division
plain_english: And to know fully the division of the eightfold groups in its endless extent.
